title: Distributed Edge Computing Task Allocation with Network Effects
summary: Field-deployable edge computing nodes form a network and are used to complete scientific tasks for remote sensing and monitoring. The networked nodes collectively decide which scientific applications to run while they are constrained by various factors, such as differing hardware constraints from heterogeneous nodes and time-varying quality of service (QoS) requirements. We model the problem of task allocation as an optimization problem that maximizes the QoS, subject to the constraints.
